name: Technology Transfer and Absorption
description:
This course contains the following topics:
Introduction and overview of Technology/Knowledge Transfer: Need, Nature and Concepts
Process and Models of Technology/K Transfer, Inter-firm & Lab to Field.
Negotiation/Barriers for Technology Transfer 
Technology Transfer agreements/ Govt. Policy on Technology Imports 
Introduction, Terminology, Constraints; Adoption and Adaptation
Disruptive Technologies: Strategies & Innovation System
